results.reason: CompleraEviplera refers to the same drug, marketed as Complera in the US and Eviplera in the EU.
LDVSOF refers to the combination of ledipasvir and sofosbuvir, which is marketed as Harvoni.
The member OPSUMITOPSYNVI runs together the names of two different drugs, Opsumit and Opsynvi, which are not the same product.
The member 'HIVProductSales' is a category covering multiple products, not a single product.
